task.title: R1A: decouple ExecutionEngine from Electron main
task.objective: Execute R1A only by replacing ExecutionEngine's session.ipc and profileStores imports with the minimum framework-independent injected session-access and report-persistence ports, composed from existing Electron main without changing runtime, persistence, licensing, offline, security, or compatibility behavior.

architecture: R1A only: do not begin R1B store coordination, R2 IPC decomposition, or later refactoring phases.
Keep ExecutionEngine authoritative and create no replacement engine, contracts layer, orchestrator, browser owner, queue, policy system, repository framework, or telemetry store.
Remove only the session.ipc and profileStores upward imports; retain the separately sanctioned appPaths bridge.
Compose production ports in the existing execution IPC composition root and retain safe constructor behavior for verifier and benchmark engines.
security: Preserve sender authorization, protected-login/manual-handoff behavior, all thirteen independent licensing checkpoint groups, secret masking, and app-owned session profiles.
No CAPTCHA, MFA, OTP, passkey, approval, bot-detection, or daily-browser-profile automation is introduced.
compatibility: No persisted file shape, id, folder, default, lifecycle status, JSON report, SQLite row, session profile, or preload/IPC API contract changes.
Report profile import and session reuse/capture access retain current production behavior through injected concrete adapters.
offline: No runtime network dependency, new dependency, resource-path change, global browser/runtime dependency, or mutable write under resources/app.asar.

acceptance.description: ExecutionEngine consumes only narrow framework-independent session-access and report-persistence ports, with no forbidden or replacement Electron-main dependency and with appPaths still permitted.
Session reuse, report persistence, lifecycle, cancellation, capacity, concurrency, and independent licensing semantics remain unchanged through the production composition.
JSON/profile/report compatibility, source hygiene, and strict offline behavior remain green without R1B or R2 scope.
Beads, ledger, assignment, plans and AI state record current evidence; task gate passes; roadmap Overview says Sources agree; coherent commits are pushed to main.
